texts.label: A
fehler: "Maren had stopped on her way back from the med room to refill the water pitcher, out of a habit she didn't examine." – unclear why the chapel and the pitcher belong together; the motivation is left hanging
"She said the nurse with the cold hands was the one who sang." – a sentimental key line that drifts toward a revelation
"He didn't turn when the door sighed shut behind her." – a worn-out personification
"a woman on 4 West who asked for nothing but a song she couldn't finish" – ambiguous about who couldn't finish, and it edges into kitsch
At roughly 330 words, clearly over the target of about 250, and the ending merely repeats the hymnal action shown earlier

texts.label: B
fehler: "where the corridor moved in pale strips" – a hazy image whose meaning is unclear
"coat folded beside him" vs. "A damp mark darkened one shoulder of his coat" – hard to see on a folded coat; small logic break

"the chapel window held her reflection over his: her white shoes, his dark coat, the three stirrers" – the reflection logic is strained (shoes and table in a small door window, seen from the corridor)
"She went to the table and straightened the cup, though it was already steady." – a slightly over-explained gesture
"His voice was ordinary, almost apologetic." – tells rather than shows

texts.label: C
fehler: "She thought of the phone in her pocket, the weight of it." – a familiar formula
"as if he'd been saying it silently for some time" – a slightly explanatory simile
"I wanted to sit somewhere that was awake." – a borderline line of dialogue that leans poetic
Slightly over length (approx. 270 words)

texts.label: D
fehler: "I was told to wait." – hints at the supernatural more obviously than the rest of the text
"She could have stood and asked again in the voice she used when visitors blocked a doorway." – a somewhat long-winded aside
"Her badge was clipped to her waistband, turned inward. She checked it anyway." – a motif the other texts use too; somewhat predictable
Slightly over length (approx. 270 words)

texts.label: E
fehler: "Kindness leaves the heat on. I read that somewhere." – a kitschy aphorism
"I just wanted to sit where someone kind had been, that's all." – sentimental, spells out the emotion
"because people came here for the worst reasons" – a cliché and an explanation
"taillights two slow red breaths in the dark, going." – overwrought final image
"Room 412. She died in March, right around this hour." – lays out the backstory as a revelation, against the restraint the task asks for
